    #Görsel vitrin

    Dosya: theme/bloklar/gorsel-vitrin.html · Ham dosya · Smarty

    {assign var="THUMBNAIL" value=$SHOWCASE.S11}
{assign var="MOUSEWHEEL" value=$SHOWCASE.S14}
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="/theme/standart/js/gorsel_vitrin/owl/assets/owl.animate.css"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="/theme/standart/js/gorsel_vitrin/owl/assets/owl.carousel.min.css"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="/theme/standart/js/gorsel_vitrin/owl/assets/owl.theme.default.min.css"/>
<script type="text/javascript" src="/theme/standart/js/gorsel_vitrin/owl/owl.carousel.min.js"></script>
<script type="text/javascript" src="/theme/standart/js/gorsel_vitrin/owl/owl.animate.js"></script>
{if $SHOWCASE.S2 == true}
    <script type="text/javascript" src="/theme/standart/js/gorsel_vitrin/owl/owl.autoplay.js"></script>
{/if}
{if $SHOWCASE.S8 == true}
    <script type="text/javascript" src="/theme/standart/js/gorsel_vitrin/owl/owl.navigation.js"></script>
{/if}
{if $SHOWCASE.S10 == true}
    <script type="text/javascript" src="/theme/standart/js/gorsel_vitrin/owl/owl.lazyload.js"></script>
{/if}
{if $THUMBNAIL == 'true'}
    <script type="text/javascript" src="/theme/standart/js/gorsel_vitrin/owl/owl.thumbnail.js"></script>
{/if}
{if $MOUSEWHEEL == 'true'}
    <script type="text/javascript" src="/theme/standart/js/gorsel_vitrin/owl/owl.mousewheel.min.js"></script>
{/if}
<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        var owl = $('.owl-carousel{$BLOCK_ID}');
        owl.on('initialize.owl.carousel initialized.owl.carousel ' +
        'initialize.owl.carousel initialize.owl.carousel ' +
        'resize.owl.carousel resized.owl.carousel ' +
        'refresh.owl.carousel refreshed.owl.carousel ' +
        'update.owl.carousel updated.owl.carousel ' +
        'drag.owl.carousel dragged.owl.carousel ' +
        'translate.owl.carousel translated.owl.carousel ' +
        'to.owl.carousel changed.owl.carousel',
        function(e){
            $('.' + e.type).removeClass('secondary').addClass('success');
            window.setTimeout(function() {
                $('.' + e.type).removeClass('success').addClass('secondary');
            }, 500);
        });
        owl.owlCarousel({
            items: {$SHOWCASE.S1},
            autoplay: {$SHOWCASE.S2},
            autoplayTimeout: {$SHOWCASE.S3},
            autoplayHoverPause: {$SHOWCASE.S4},
            {if $SHOWCASE.S5 == flipInX}
                animateIn: '{$SHOWCASE.S5}',
                animateOut: 'slideOutDown',
            {else if $SHOWCASE.S5 == fadeOut || $SHOWCASE.S5 == slideOutDown}
                animateOut: '{$SHOWCASE.S5}',
            {/if}
            center: {$SHOWCASE.S6},
            loop: {$SHOWCASE.S7},
            nav: {$SHOWCASE.S8},
            rtl: {$SHOWCASE.S9},
            lazyLoad: {$SHOWCASE.S10},
            {if $THUMBNAIL == 'true'}
                thumbs: true,
                thumbsPrerendered: true,
            {/if}
            dots: {$SHOWCASE.S13}
          });
        {if $MOUSEWHEEL == 'true'}
          	owl.on('mousewheel', '.owl-stage', function(e){
                if(e.deltaY > 0){
                    owl.trigger('next.owl');
                }
                else{
                    owl.trigger('prev.owl');
                }
                e.preventDefault();
            });
        {/if}
    });
</script>
<style type="text/css">
    .animated{
        -webkit-animation-duration:1000 ms;
        animation-duration:1000ms;
        -webkit-animation-fill-mode:both;
        animation-fill-mode:both;
    }

    .owl-animated-out{
        z-index:1;
    }

    .owl-animated-in{
        z-index:0;
    }

    .fadeOut{
        -webkit-animation-name:fadeOut;
        animation-name:fadeOut;
    }

    @-webkit-keyframes fadeOut{
        0%{
            opacity:1;
        }  
        100%{
            opacity:0;
        }  
    }

    @keyframes fadeOut{
        0%{
            opacity:1;
        }  
        100%{
            opacity:0;
        }  
    }

    .owl-theme .owl-nav{
        position:absolute;
        top:0;
        left:0;
        width:100%;
        height:0;
        margin-top:0;
    }

    .owl-theme .owl-nav [class*=owl-]{
        width:10px;
        height:30px;
        text-indent:-9999em;
        padding:0;
        background-color:transparent;
        background-image:url('/Data/EditorFiles/owl/assets/arrows.png');
        background-repeat:no-repeat;
        margin:0;
        overflow:hidden;
        cursor:pointer;
    }
    .owl-prev {
        background: url(/Data/EditorFiles/leftArrow.png)no-repeat 12px center !important;
        width: 35px !important;
        min-height: 580px;
    }
    .owl-next {
        background: url(/Data/EditorFiles/rightArrow.png)no-repeat 12px center !important;
        width: 35px !important;
        min-height: 580px;
    }
    .owl-carousel .owl-nav .owl-prev{
        float:left;
    }

    .owl-carousel .owl-nav .owl-next{
        float:right;
        background-position:right 0;
    }

    .owl-theme .owl-nav [class*=owl-]:hover{
        background-color:transparent;
    }
</style>
<div class="col col-12">
    <div class="row mb">
        <div class="fl col-12 owl-carousel owl-carousel{$BLOCK_ID} owl-theme"{if $THUMBNAIL == 'true'} data-slider-id="1"{/if}>
            {foreach $IMAGE_LIST as $GORSEL}
                <div class="item">
                	<a href="{$GORSEL.LINK}" class="fl col-12">
                          <img alt="{$GORSEL.ALT}" src="{$GORSEL.IMAGE}" class="fl col-12" />
                    </a>
                </div>
            {/foreach}
        </div>
        {if $THUMBNAIL == 'true'}
            <div class="box col-12 p-right dn-xs">
                <div class="row">
                    <div class="fl col-12 owl-thumbs" data-slider-id="1">
                        {foreach $IMAGE_LIST as $GORSEL}
                            <span class="col col-{12 / $SHOWCASE.S12} p-left owl-thumb-item">
                      			<img alt="{$GORSEL.ALT}" src="{$GORSEL.THUMBNAIL}" class="fl col-12" />
                            </span>
                        {/foreach}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        {/if}
       </div>
</div>
<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function(){
        $(".owl-thumbs .owl-thumb-item").mouseover(function(){
            $(this).trigger("click");
            });
    })
</script>
